AdStrat bookmark: full code

Use this if the short bookmark says it "could not load". It's the same code, without loading anything from the internet.

If Copy doesn't work: tap inside the box, Select all, then Copy.

  1. Copy the code above.
  2. Edit your Copy AdStrat claims bookmark: delete its address and paste this code. Check it starts with javascript:.
  3. On your AdStrat claims list, tap the bookmark, then Copy for tracker.
  4. In the tracker: Claims → ⟳ Sync from AdStrat.

This page changes when the bookmark is updated. If the short bookmark works for you, you never need it.
